intent: An operator can preserve a skill its owner deleted before a complaint arrived.
observable_outcome: get-context registry lists the amended rule as reviewed, proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A purge keeps the row of a skill that has test cases or a version referenced by a run, a download or a bundle; the deleted-skill sweep also keeps a skill while its publication is unretired or retired less than the ninety-day name hold ago, and while an operator takedown or access restriction is in force on it. An operator can take down or restrict a skill its owner has deleted until the sweep purges it, and the operator's skill search lists such a skill with when it was deleted.
